name: Call Of Duty: BO6 Experience
summary: Interactive experience for Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
overview: Reveal microsite for the new Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 game as the hub of a large integrated digital and OOH marketing campaign. The experience features a fully functional 90s analog tv with realtime webgl effects for authentic static, on screen displays, and working physical buttons. A collection of hidden easter eggs were rolled out to really engage fans of the franchise. The award-winning microsite received over 500,000 visitors on launch day and was a top trending search on twitter.
